## 💡 Feature Summary

A clear and concise summary of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?
> *Example: "As a student, I can't easily track which books are due soon, so I sometimes miss return deadlines."*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

Describe the feature/solution in detail. How should it work? What should the UI look like?

## 👥 User Role Affected

- [ ] Student
- [ ] Teacher
- [ ] Admin
- [ ] All users / Public

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why are they not sufficient?

## 🖼️ Mockups / Examples

If you have any UI sketches, mockups, or examples from other apps, add them here.

## ➕ Additional Context

Any other information, links, or context relevant to this request.
